intro: Gracella invites you into quiet indulgence. Soft microfibre upholstery and concealed hydraulic storage come together to create a bedroom retreat that feels composed, luxurious, and effortlessly calm.

features.title: Refined upholstery
features.text: Designed with premium microfibre upholstery in a sophisticated blue, Gracella delivers a soft, tactile surface that enhances comfort while lending the bed a calm, contemporary luxury appeal.

features.title: Statement headrest
features.text: A generously proportioned upholstered headrest creates a refined backdrop for everyday unwinding, offering plush back support that lets you lounge, read, or relax in suite-like comfort—right in your own bedroom.

features.title: Effortless hydraulic storage
features.text: You can lift the bed base smoothly using the fabric grip handles to reveal generous hydraulic storage beneath. The hydraulic storage provides easy access to essentials while maintaining a visually calm and beautifully uncluttered bedroom.

features.title: End-to-End Storage
features.text: A thoughtfully planned storage layout with a full-length central partition allows you to organise bedding, linens, and seasonal pieces neatly on either side.

features.title: Built to last
features.text: The bed is designed with a robust MDF baton mattress panel with non-woven reinforcement, giving you dependable support, lasting stability, and consistent comfort through everyday use.

features.title: King-Only Statement
features.text: Available exclusively in king size, the Gracella Bed is designed to make a bold yet refined statement, offering expansive comfort with a distinctly premium presence.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
